title: Newhalo contact form
description: A contact section on paper: a 64px heading over a column of outlined fields with labels set into their borders (text, select, email, phone, message), a consent checkbox and a send button that stays greyed out until the form is valid; on the right a tall white card with a 32px prompt and a full-width orange button. Fields fade in one by one; the card rises in.
notes: no JavaScript: the button's disabled look is CSS (:has(:invalid))
